Package de.nexus.antixray.api.event

Class BaitVeinHitEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
de.nexus.antixray.api.event.BaitVeinHitEvent
public class BaitVeinHitEvent extends org.bukkit.event.player.PlayerEvent
Called each time the x-ray detection counts a bait vein for a player.

A bait vein is a fake ore vein of a type listed under xray-detection.bait-ores. It counts when the player breaks one of its blocks or a block right next to it, and only once within the detection window: digging out the rest of the same vein does not call the event again. Fake veins of other types and real ores do not call it.

Only players the detection watches cause this event: survival or adventure mode, fake ores active for the player (not bypassed, world not disabled) and xray-detection.enabled.

One hit says little. Honest miners run into a bait vein now and then; the detection looks at the rate over time. When the event is called the hit is already counted, so NexusAntiXRayApi.getStats(java.util.UUID) includes it. If the hit makes an alert due, XRayAlertEvent follows right after this event.

The event cannot be cancelled.

Thread

The event is synchronous. It is called on the thread that ticks the player: the server thread, on Folia the region thread that owns the player. It is never called from a network or ray tracing thread.

It is called from inside the BlockBreakEvent of the mined block (priority MONITOR). Do not kick, teleport or otherwise remove the player right in the handler; schedule that for the next tick.

Since:
1.0.0
